summary_en: BALNIBARBI will acquire up to 100,000 shares (0.92% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥110 million via open market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 1 to November 30, 2026, to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
BALNIBARBI's board of directors resolved on September 9, 2026, to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied by Article 165, Paragraph 3. The company will acquire up to 100,000 ordinary shares for a maximum expenditure of ¥110 million through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 1 through November 30, 2026. This represents 0.92% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026, when the company held 149,105 treasury shares against 10,813,275 issued shares excluding treasury stock.

The acquisition is intended to enhance capital efficiency and return profits to shareholders. It will also enable the company to pursue flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. The acquisition will be conducted through ordinary market purchases without a specified price ceiling per share.
